codeReview.summary: Pass. The feature covers the requested Linear tracking foundation work: `linear-closeout-scope.json` freezes the mission closeout inventory with the open-at-start and mission-created issue sets, the repo-bound status-update draft records that frozen scope, and `src/control-plane/extensions/linear/commands.ts` now routes project artifact families through the repo root so canonical `.hack/linear/projects/<project-id>/...` paths are used instead of the legacy `.hack/.hack/linear` tree. The added regression in `tests/linear-commands.test.ts` protects the root-resolution fix, while existing project-artifact tests continue to cover pull/apply/publish behavior for documents, milestones, and status updates.
